easyPrerequisites:
Triskelion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Massacre Girl has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Massacre Girl using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Massacre Girl's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
